19.3 • Implement Nutritional Strategies to Impact Musculoskeletal and Integumentary Wellness

Function 
Nutritional Importance 
Nutrients to Support System 
Musculoskeletal System 
• Supports the body’s weight 
and provides stability and 
movement 
• Malnutrition can severely 
impair the musculoskeletal 
system. 
• Proper nutrition is important 
to minimize normal bone loss 
that occurs over time. 
• A healthy diet promotes 
healthy weight which 
decreases the strain on 
bones, joints, muscles and 
ligaments. 
• Proper nutrition assists to 
decrease inflammation, 
promote bone marrow 
production, and maintain 
overall mobility. 
• Foods with anti-inflammatory 
properties: 
◦ Nuts 
◦ Fruits (blackberries, 
blueberries, avocados, 
grapes, cherries) 
◦ Turmeric 
◦ Omega-3 fatty acids 
(salmon) 
◦ Green tea 
◦ Olive oil
